sloka: तौ वीरशयने वीरौ शयानौ रुधिरोक्षितौ ।शरवेष्टितसर्वाङ्गावार्तौ परमपीडितौ ।। ६.४५.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: tau vīraśayane vīrau śayānau rudhirokṣitau ।śaraveṣṭitasarvāṅgāvārtau paramapīḍitau ।। 6.45.19 ।।।।

translations.english: The princes were lying on the warrior's bed in the battlefield, their limbs fully covered with arrows, in a highly distressed state.
